subject.title: message tool: Feishu send action polluted by poll schema/guard prevents file send

question: Should the shared model-facing `message` tool be narrowed by action/channel so poll creation fields are not present on ordinary sends, or should the unified schema stay and sanitize poll fields at runtime for `action="send"`?
rationale: The remaining failure is a shared tool-contract decision, not only a local guard tweak: it affects model-facing schema shape, poll creation semantics, and channel-specific message reliability.

options.title: Narrow send schema
options.body: Move poll creation fields out of the ordinary send schema and keep poll behavior in a dedicated action/schema while preserving current poll validation.

options.title: Sanitize send params
options.body: Keep the unified schema but strip poll creation fields for `action="send"` before the guard and channel dispatch.

options.title: Adopt linked PR direction
options.body: Use the open external PR as design input only after resolving conflicts and confirming the resulting branch matches OpenClaw's current owner boundaries.

recommendation.title: Narrow send schema
recommendation.body: Move poll creation fields out of the ordinary send schema and keep poll behavior in a dedicated action/schema while preserving current poll validation.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and later refactored the poll/message-tool schema and guard surface, making them the best available routing candidate for this contract choice.
